title: BOBBY'S ROOM BIGGEST Nemesis RIPS It!! I Call w/$8,500+ In The Middle! I Go On Huge HEATER!!
summary: 벨라지오 Bobby's Room 25/50 세션. 초반에 JT 스트레이트에 당하고 Big Wave Dave 와의 $9,000 플립에서 져서 -$6,000 까지 밀린다. KT 봄팟에서 AA 를 블러프로 폴드시키고, 73o 로 더블 배럴 블러프를 성공시키며 후반 3시간에 만회해 +$3,000 으로 마감한다. 내레이션 90% 는 대본형이라 문장이 깔끔하고, 마지막 2분 아웃트로만 진짜 구어(um/uh/cuz)다.

hands.result: 턴 플러시 메이드, 리버 $2,000 벳 → 폴드 (소액 +)

hands.label: K♥Q♥ 버튼 vs Dave 림프-잼 $9,000
hands.result: TT 에 플립 패배, $4,000 추가 바이인 (−−)

hands.label: Q♠T♦ vs Dave
hands.result: 리버 민레이즈 콜 → 짐, 슬로롤 당함 (−)

hands.label: J♠J♦ 5-way
hands.result: 세컨드 페어로 콜 한 번 → 쇼다운 승 (+)

hands.label: 6♦3♦ 빅블라인드 스트레이트플러시 드로우

chunks.quote: One thing I know for sure is that our hand is susceptible to being downgraded.
chunks.en: likely to be influenced or harmed by a particular thing
chunks.note: 뒤에 명사/동명사. TOEFL RC 에서 'susceptible to disease/erosion' 형태로 자주. vulnerable to 와 거의 동의

chunks.quote: Our hand is a bit vulnerable to over cards coming out.
chunks.en: exposed to the possibility of being attacked or harmed
chunks.note: susceptible 이 '영향받기 쉬움'이라면 vulnerable 은 '방어가 약함'. 같은 영상에서 둘 다 쓴 게 좋은 비교 자료

chunks.quote: We're always going to open with our suited Broadway cards regardless of position.
chunks.en: without being affected by; no matter what
chunks.note: 전치사구. 절이 오면 regardless of whether… 라이팅에서 '어떤 조건이든'을 한 단어로

chunks.quote: We begin play right around noon with aspirations of booking another five-figure win.
chunks.en: a strong desire or ambition to achieve something
chunks.note: aspiration of + 동명사 / aspiration to + 원형 둘 다. MBA 에세이 단골

chunks.quote: I don't see how we can withstand another bet after the opponent bet into four players on the turn.
chunks.en: to remain undamaged or unaffected by; to resist
chunks.note: 23:46 에도 'withstand the noise… withstand a three-bet' 로 두 번. 타동사, 목적어 바로

chunks.quote: Our instincts allow us to steal a substantial pot to get us close to the even mark.
chunks.en: of considerable importance, size, or worth
chunks.note: 22:54 의 sizable 과 동의. 아카데믹에서는 substantial evidence/increase

chunks.quote: I check back to make our goal more feasible.
chunks.en: possible to do easily or conveniently
chunks.note: possible 보다 '현실적으로 가능'. 라이팅에서 solution/plan 을 꾸밀 때

chunks.quote: He could also have something like pocket 10s or pocket jacks he's reluctant to give up on.
chunks.en: unwilling and hesitant to do something
chunks.note: be reluctant to + 원형. 리스닝 대화에서 교수/학생 태도 묘사로 자주

chunks.quote: Dave almost never folds when I come in for a raise and he still has cards, so I don't anticipate him abandoning his hand.
chunks.en: to expect or predict that something will happen
chunks.note: anticipate + 목적어 + 동명사 구조 주목(anticipate him abandoning). 23:39 'anticipating that…' 도

chunks.quote: He has to have a hand with at least some value he's contemplating bluff catching us with.
chunks.en: to think about something carefully for a long time
chunks.note: consider 의 격식체. contemplate + 동명사. 22:02 에도 'contemplating a check-raise'

chunks.quote: I check hoping to induce a value bet from a worse hand or a bluff from some type of straight or flush draw.
chunks.en: to cause or bring about something, often deliberately
chunks.note: 과학 지문에서 'induce a response/reaction'. 포커에서는 '상대의 벳을 끌어내다'. 12:37, 28:24 에도

chunks.quote: A lot of unorthodox things keep happening, causing me to find creative ways to lose, but it's a sign of a good game.
chunks.en: not conforming to what is usual or accepted; unconventional
chunks.note: unconventional 의 동의어. 역사·예술 지문에서 인물 묘사로

chunks.quote: More so because the ace of spades isn't accounted for.
chunks.en: included in a calculation; whose location or status is known
chunks.note: account for = 설명하다/차지하다. 수동태 'isn't accounted for' = 어디 있는지 모른다

chunks.quote: Ultimately, the middle position player makes the call.
chunks.en: finally; in the end, after everything else has been considered
chunks.note: 스피킹 결론 문장 첫 단어로. 'Ultimately, I believe…'

chunks.quote: He was clearly out to get me by cold calling a three-bet with a hand that's objectively awful.
chunks.en: in a way not influenced by personal feelings or opinions
chunks.note: 'objectively awful' = 누가 봐도 형편없는. 반의어 subjectively

chunks.quote: We're going to take advantage of his loose tendencies.
chunks.en: to make good use of an opportunity; to exploit
chunks.note: tendencies(경향) 도 같이. 'exploit' 의 중립적 표현

chunks.quote: There's been tons of action lately and I've been running lights out.
chunks.note: run = 포커에서 '운이 흐르다'. run good/bad/hot. lights out = 압도적으로

chunks.quote: He's told me he's out for revenge.
chunks.note: out for X = X 를 노리는. 20:25 'out to get me' 와 세트

chunks.quote: I've gotten the best of him in the first two sessions we played together.
chunks.note: 경기·논쟁에서. 'My nerves got the best of me' = 긴장에 졌다

chunks.quote: I'm confident that I'll be able to get unstuck, and maybe even book a large win.
chunks.note: 00:30 'booking another five-figure win', 30:04 'allow us to book a win'. 3번 반복 — Brad 의 시그니처

chunks.quote: My gut's telling me that we don't have the best hand.
chunks.note: gut = 직감. gut feeling / go with your gut. 스피킹에서 'I think' 대신 쓰면 자연스러움

chunks.quote: Rather than call, I lean hard into our removal with a raise to 3,000.
chunks.note: 최근 10년 유행 표현. 'lean into the discomfort'

chunks.quote: I'm just waiting for someone to take a stab at the pot so that I can fold and move on to the next hand.
chunks.note: 'Let me take a stab at it' = 내가 한번 해볼게. 회의에서 유용

chunks.quote: …so that I can fold and move on to the next hand.
chunks.note: 프레젠테이션 전환어 'Let's move on to the next point'

chunks.quote: Things keep going like this, might have to get a bit more creative if I'm going to pull out a win today.
chunks.note: pull out = 힘들게 꺼내다. 'pull out a victory in the final minutes'

chunks.quote: I'm starting to string multiple wins together at least.
chunks.note: string wins/sentences/days together. 26:59 'in a groove', 27:04 'in droves' 와 한 묶음

chunks.quote: I'm in a groove. There's reason to be optimistic.
chunks.note: get into a groove. 반대는 in a rut(침체)

chunks.quote: The strong hands that I wasn't getting in the beginning of the session are coming in droves.
chunks.note: 'People left in droves' = 사람들이 우르르 떠났다

chunks.quote: We were down over 6,000 until we hit a mini rush to make a comeback the last 3 hours.
chunks.note: 30:36 'battled back' 도 같은 뜻. 스피킹 경험담에 딱

chunks.quote: We're within striking distance of the even mark.
chunks.note: the even mark = 본전. 05:29 'hovering around the even mark' 도

chunks.expr: see it coming from a mile away
chunks.quote: He was trying to jerk me around a little with the slow roll, but I saw it coming from a mile away.
chunks.note: jerk someone around = 갖고 놀다, 애먹이다

chunks.expr: never hear the end of it
chunks.quote: If I fold and there's any chance this is a bluff, I'm certainly never going to hear the end of it.
chunks.note: 13:30 'get needled by Dave' 도 같은 맥락. needle = 콕콕 찌르며 놀리다

chunks.quote: I mostly rule out him having a king or deuce since there's no reason that he should expect me to bet.
chunks.note: rule out + 목적어 + 동명사. 의료·과학에서도 'rule out infection'

chunks.quote: To be on the safe side, I'm not going to keep rifling money into the pot.
chunks.note: 'Just to be on the safe side' 로 문장 앞에

chunks.quote: Our opponent strikes me as someone who could be a bit more loose.
chunks.note: 'He strikes me as honest' = 정직해 보인다. seem 의 세련된 대체

chunks.quote: Then again, he could have a straight draw or high pocket pair and he might hate seeing the board pair.
chunks.note: 자기 말을 뒤집을 때. 스피킹에서 양면 검토할 때 유용

chunks.quote: The thing is that I was mostly repping a set or two pair on the flop.
chunks.note: 05:16 'The problem is', 16:46 'The issue is' 와 같은 틀. 핵심을 꺼낼 때

chunks.quote: I don't blame him, but it's time for us to put him in check a bit.
chunks.note: 체스 '체크'에서. keep something in check = 억제하다

chunks.quote: He's going to apply some pressure. He bets 500.
chunks.note: 협상·스포츠 공통

chunks.quote: Our hand is right on the cusp of a call or fold.
chunks.note: on the cusp of a breakthrough = 돌파 직전

chunks.quote: It's too steep of a price for the button.
chunks.note: steep = 가격이 가파른(비싼). 'too + 형용사 + of a + 명사' 구어 구조

chunks.quote: It looks like he's decided he's going to bet. It's just a matter of how much.
chunks.note: a matter of time/when/if. 'It's not a matter of if, but when'

chunks.quote: He owns my soul by accidentally getting two streets of value with air.
chunks.note: 포커 슬랭. 'He owns me' = 나를 갖고 논다

chunks.quote: I'm not running quite as well as I did the first few sessions, when I was getting hit by the deck.
chunks.note: 포커 한정이지만 'hit by' 구조는 일반적

chunks.quote: He could just have something like queen jack that he's going wild with for funsies.
chunks.note: for fun 의 장난스러운 변형. 캐주얼 대화 전용

chunks.quote: He tends to open limp fairly often, so no alarm bells are really going off.
chunks.note: 'That set off alarm bells' = 경계심이 들었다

chunks.quote: All the more details in future episodes, but be on the lookout for that.
chunks.note: 'Be on the lookout for scams'

chunks.quote: I'm making up for a trip that I originally planned last year.
chunks.note: make up for lost time. compensate for 의 구어

chunks.quote: With six opponents, it can be dicey trying to win a bomb pot with only one pair.
chunks.note: dice(주사위)에서. risky 의 구어

chunks.quote: The opponent is too savvy.
chunks.note: tech-savvy, business-savvy 로 합성 가능

chunks.quote: I tend to be a pretty low-key guy. I don't like shiny things that often.
chunks.note: tend to be (경향) 도 같이. 최근 부사로 'I low-key love it' = 살짝

grammar.pattern: Rather than + 원형, S + V + in order to + 원형
grammar.quote: Rather than call, I lean hard into our removal with a raise to 3,000 in order to mostly represent a straight, set, or top two pair.
grammar.toefl: Speaking 독립형 답변의 핵심 문장. 'Rather than [버린 선택], I would [결정] in order to [목적]' 한 문장에 비교·결정·이유가 다 들어간다.
grammar.explain: rather than 뒤에는 동사원형(call) 이 온다 — 동명사도 가능하지만 Brad 는 원형. in order to 는 to 부정사의 목적 용법을 명시한 것. 이 영상 전체가 이 구조의 변주다: 'I bet 300 to protect any equity' (10:26), 'I check back for pot control' (01:15), 'I bet 400 to fold out the small pocket pairs' (21:39).

grammar.pattern: 헤지 — may or may not / there's a chance that / could easily be / it's (un)likely that
grammar.quote: We may or may not be best. … There's a chance that we're up against the nuts or the second nuts. … I could easily be drawing dead.
grammar.toefl: 아카데믹 영어의 기본 예절. Writing/Speaking 에서 'X is true' 대신 'X may or may not hold', 'There's a chance that', 'is likely to' 로 쓰면 점수가 올라간다.
grammar.explain: Brad 는 확신 없는 판단을 절대 단정하지 않는다. 확실도 순서: could easily be (낮음) < may or may not (반반) < there's a strong possibility (15:34, 높음) < one thing I know for sure (10:22, 확실). 이 네 단계를 그대로 외워 두면 스피킹에서 자기 의견의 강도를 조절할 수 있다.

grammar.pattern: 가정법 과거완료 — would/could have + p.p. (+ if S had p.p.)
grammar.quote: Now, I'm certainly regretting not going for the check-raise on the flop. I could have even done it on the turn. I also could have folded pre-flop.
grammar.toefl: Speaking 'Describe a decision you regret' 유형. 'I could have…, I should have…' 로 대안을 나열하고 'It couldn't have gone much worse' 로 마무리.
grammar.explain: 03:20 'He would have ripped it by now if he had us beat' 는 정석 형태(주절 would have p.p. + if 절 had p.p.). 09:29 'It couldn't have run out much worse' 는 if 절 없이 쓴 축약형. regret + 동명사(regretting not going) 구조도 주목 — regret to 는 '유감이지만 ~하다'로 뜻이 다르다.

grammar.pattern: 현재분사 후치 수식으로 결과 덧붙이기 — …, V-ing …
grammar.quote: The dealer puts out the king of hearts downgrading us to second pair.
grammar.toefl: Writing 통합형에서 문장을 붙이는 도구. 'The policy was introduced in 1990, reducing unemployment by 3%.' 처럼 결과를 콤마 + V-ing 로 잇는다.
grammar.explain: 04:13 'The turn is the three of diamonds giving us a full house', 15:09 'The turn is the six of clubs, putting a second flush draw on the board', 16:10 'completing the back door flush draw and putting four to the straight on board' — 영상에 최소 6번. 주어가 같을 때 'and it gives us' 대신 'giving us' 로 줄이는 것. 두 결과는 and 로 병렬(completing… and putting…).

grammar.pattern: 원인·조건·목적 접속 — due to the fact that / now that / as long as / so that
grammar.quote: This is a slightly larger sizing than I normally use due to the fact that my opponent doesn't like to fold against me.
grammar.toefl: Writing 에서 because 만 반복하면 감점. due to the fact that(원인), now that(~이제 ~이므로), as long as(조건), so that(목적) 을 번갈아 쓴다.
grammar.explain: due to + 명사 / due to the fact that + 절. now that 은 15:34 'He has more info to work with now that he's seen everyone check' — '이제 ~했으니'. as long as 는 15:51 'as long as I can beat the hijack, we can potentially take down the pot' — 조건. so that 은 15:15 목적. 넷 다 문장 중간에서 절을 이끈다.

grammar.pattern: 강조 구문 — If there's anyone who…, it's X / One thing I know for sure is that…
grammar.quote: If there's anyone at the table who's earned action, it's Big Wave Dave.
grammar.toefl: Speaking 오프닝. 'If there's one thing I've learned, it's that…' / 'One thing I know for sure is that…' 로 시작하면 답변에 무게가 실린다.
grammar.explain: 둘 다 뒤에 오는 정보를 강조하는 틀. 10:22 'One thing I know for sure is that our hand is susceptible…' 는 that 절이 보어. 08:33 'I don't scratch my head unless it itches. I don't dance unless I hear music' 는 unless 를 반복한 병렬 강조 — 리듬 때문에 쉐도잉하기 좋다.

grammar.quote: After a quick trip to Northern California, playing a session you saw in the last episode, I'm back in Las Vegas ready to battle in Bobby's Room.
grammar.toefl: Reading 첫 문장 유형. 주어(I) 가 문장 중반에야 나온다. 'After…, [V-ing]…, S + V' 구조를 보면 콤마 앞은 배경, 주절부터가 본론.
grammar.explain: After a quick trip(전치사구) + playing a session(분사구, 앞의 trip 을 설명) + I'm back(주절) + ready to battle(형용사구 보충). 03:26 'just like after assembling a whole bedroom set from IKEA, we don't get paid in the end' 도 같은 구조에 비유까지 얹은 것.

shadow.why: 오프닝. 긴 도입 문장 + 완료시제(I've gotten, I've been running, he's told me) 가 집중돼 있고 은어가 거의 없다. 리듬이 안정적이라 첫 쉐도잉으로 적합.
shadow.text: After a quick trip to Northern California, playing a session you saw in the last episode, I'm back in Las Vegas ready to battle in Bobby's Room. Usually this time of year is pretty slow on the strip after the WSOP ends, but there's been tons of action lately and I've been running lights out. I buy in 25/50 for $10,000. Big Wave Dave is still in town. I've gotten the best of him in the first two sessions we played together, including winning a pot of nearly $20,000 against him last time, but he's told me he's out for revenge. We begin play right around noon with aspirations of booking another five-figure win.

shadow.why: 리텔 핸드의 결정 구간. 'My gut's telling me' → 'Rather than call, I lean hard into… in order to' → 'There's a chance that' 가 44초 안에 다 나온다. 이 구간을 외우면 리텔 뼈대가 생긴다.
shadow.text: The turn is the queen of spades. We pick up a gutshot straight draw, and we've already got removal to the nuts, but the small blind unexpectedly leads for 1,100. We're up against a recreational opponent who normally likes to play 100 200 or higher. My gut's telling me that we don't have the best hand, but also that the opponent has a hand he's not super confident in, either. Could have something like queen jack. Rather than call, I lean hard into our removal with a raise to 3,000 in order to mostly represent a straight, set, or top two pair. The small blind doesn't immediately fold like I was hoping. There's a chance that we're up against the nuts or the second nuts, and torching several thousand dollars. Each second that the opponent is in the tank feels like an eternity. After 40 seconds of thinking over his options, the small blind finally makes the fold.

shadow.why: 패배 후 정리 구간. 'objectively awful', 'unorthodox', 'find creative ways to lose', 'get unstuck', 'book a large win' 이 32초에 몰려 있다. 감정을 절제한 서술 톤 — TOEFL 스피킹에서 실패담을 말하는 톤이 이것.
shadow.text: The opponent shockingly reveals queen-jack offsuit. He was clearly out to get me by cold calling a three-bet with a hand that's objectively awful, especially in a spot that could have gone multi-way. But, he gets his revenge after showing up with maybe one of the few combos he'd consider folding on the turn or river after calling the flop bet. A lot of unorthodox things keep happening, causing me to find creative ways to lose, but it's a sign of a good game. I know that I'm not getting much to work with right now. If that changes, I'm confident that I'll be able to get unstuck, and maybe even book a large win. We get something to work with.

shadow.why: 결산. 'Aside from', 'All together', 'well-timed', 'make a comeback', 'walk away from… with more than…' — 하루를 요약하는 문형. 스피킹 마무리 문장 연습용.
shadow.text: I rack up after playing for 7 hours. Aside from the flush that I made early on, I didn't connect with too many boards. I rarely had better than one pair this session. I even lost a large all in flip to Dave, but a few well-timed big bluffs allow us to book a win. All together, I profited over $3,000. It's not a massive win, but we were down over 6,000 until we hit a mini rush to make a comeback the last 3 hours. I'm always happy to walk away from the poker room more money than I walked in with.

retell.hand: K♠T♦ 봄팟 — 턴 레이즈 블러프로 AA 를 폴드시킨 핸드
retell.prompt: 10:09~11:36 을 두 번 본 뒤 영상을 끄고, 이 핸드를 Brad 가 된 것처럼 영어로 해설하세요. 목표는 정확한 재현이 아니라 '결정과 이유'가 드러나는 60~90초 분량입니다. 타이핑해도 되고 녹음 후 받아써도 됩니다. 끝나면 /eng-retell w_0p4SLfV_Q 로 교정받으세요.
skeleton: 상황 — 봄팟 $200, 8명. K♠T♦ 언더더건. 플랍 T-9-4 투하트로 탑페어 + 백도어 스트레이트. 체크가 우리에게 옴.
1차 결정 — 'We may or may not be best, but…' 300 벳해서 에퀴티 보호. 스몰블라인드만 콜.
전환 — 턴 Q♠. 것샷 추가. 그런데 상대가 예상 밖으로 1,100 리드.
판단 — 'My gut's telling me…' 우리가 최고 패는 아니지만, 상대도 확신 없는 핸드(QJ 같은).
결정 + 이유 — 'Rather than call, …' 3,000 레이즈로 스트레이트/셋/탑투페어 대표. 40초 탱크 끝에 폴드. 나중에 AA 였다고 함.
retell.model: Everyone at the table is in trouble. We're playing a $200 bomb pot with king ten offsuit from under the gun. Eight of us are in. The flop comes ten nine four with two hearts. We've got top pair and a backdoor straight draw. Checks to us. We may or may not be best. One thing I know for sure is that our hand is susceptible to being downgraded. This is sort of a tricky situation, but I bet 300 to protect any equity that we've got. Most of the players aren't interested in continuing. The small blind calls. He's the only customer. It's down to heads-up, and we're in position. This is about the best outcome. The turn is the queen of spades. We pick up a gutshot straight draw, and we've already got removal to the nuts, but the small blind unexpectedly leads for 1,100. We're up against a recreational opponent who normally likes to play 100 200 or higher. My gut's telling me that we don't have the best hand, but also that the opponent has a hand he's not super confident in, either. Could have something like queen jack. Rather than call, I lean hard into our removal with a raise to 3,000 in order to mostly represent a straight, set, or top two pair. The small blind doesn't immediately fold like I was hoping. There's a chance that we're up against the nuts or the second nuts, and torching several thousand dollars. Each second that the opponent is in the tank feels like an eternity. After 40 seconds of thinking over his options, the small blind finally makes the fold. He later tells me that he mucked pocket aces. Over pairs are tough hands to play in a bomb pot. Our instincts allow us to steal a substantial pot to get us close to the even mark.
